mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, USERNAME, NAME, EMAIL, CASE WHEN USERNAME = 'admin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_ADMIN FROM MEMBER WHERE USERNAME = #{username} AND (PASSWORD = #{password} OR PASSWORD = #{hashedPassword})
SELECT MEMBER_ID, USERNAME, PASSWORD, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, PROFILE_IMAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM MEMBER WHERE USERNAME = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( USERNAME, PASSWORD, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, PROFILE_IMAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{profileImage}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, USERNAME, NAME, EMAIL, CASE WHEN USERNAME = 'admin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_ADMIN FROM MEMBER ORDER BY MEMBER_ID ASC
